import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Read data
df = pd.read_excel('/workspace/pone.0150501.s002.xls', sheet_name='RAW DATA', header=None)

# Extract sample IDs from first row
sample_ids = df.iloc[0, 1:].values
print("Sample IDs:", sample_ids)

# Group assignment: first 10 are patients (P), next 10 are controls (C)
patients = [s for s in sample_ids if s.startswith('P')]
controls = [s for s in sample_ids if s.startswith('C')]
print(f"Patients: {len(patients)}, Controls: {len(controls)}")

# Extract miRNA names and expression matrix
miRNAs = df.iloc[1:, 0].values
print(f"Number of miRNAs: {len(miRNAs)}")

# Convert expression data to numeric
data = df.iloc[1:, 1:].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
print(f"Data shape: {data.shape}")
print("Any NaN values?", data.isnull().values.any(), "Total NaNs:", data.isnull().sum().sum())

# Separate groups
data_p = data.iloc[:, :10]  # columns 0-9 are patients
data_c = data.iloc[:, 10:]  # columns 10-19 are controls

# Perform t-test for each miRNA
pvalues = []
for i in range(len(miRNAs)):
    t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(data_p.iloc[i], data_c.iloc[i], nan_policy='omit')
    pvalues.append(p_val)

pvalues = np.array(pvalues)
significant = np.sum(pvalues < 0.05)
percentage = significant / len(miRNAs) * 100

print(f"\nSignificant miRNAs before correction: {significant} out of {len(miRNAs)}")
print(f"Percentage: {percentage:.2f}%")

# Show some top miRNAs
results = pd.DataFrame({'miRNA': miRNAs, 'pvalue': pvalues})
results_sorted = results.sort_values('pvalue')
print("\nTop 10 significant miRNAs:")
print(results_sorted.head(10).to_string(index=False))

# Write answer
answer_str = f"{percentage:.1f}%"
with open('/workspace/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"<answer>{answer_str}</answer>\n")
print(f"\nAnswer written: {answer_str}")
EOF

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Read data with default header (first row becomes column name)
df = pd.read_excel('/workspace/pone.0150501.s002.xls', sheet_name='RAW DATA')

# Extract sample IDs from the first data row (index 0)
sample_ids = df.iloc[0, 1:].values.astype(str)
print("Sample IDs:", sample_ids)

# Group assignment: first 10 are patients (P), next 10 are controls (C)
patients = [s for s in sample_ids if s.startswith('P')]
controls = [s for s in sample_ids if s.startswith('C')]
print(f"Patients: {len(patients)}, Controls: {len(controls)}")

# Extract miRNA names from column 0, starting at row index 1
miRNAs = df.iloc[1:, 0].values
print(f"Number of miRNAs: {len(miRNAs)}")

# Convert expression data to numeric (rows 1 onward, columns 1-20)
data = df.iloc[1:, 1:].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
print(f"Data shape: {data.shape}")
print("Any NaN values?", data.isnull().values.any(), "Total NaNs:", data.isnull().sum().sum())

# Separate groups: first 10 columns patients, next 10 controls
data_p = data.iloc[:, :10]
data_c = data.iloc[:, 10:]

# Perform t-test for each miRNA
pvalues = []
for i in range(len(miRNAs)):
    t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(data_p.iloc[i], data_c.iloc[i], nan_policy='omit')
    pvalues.append(p_val)

pvalues = np.array(pvalues)
significant = np.sum(pvalues < 0.05)
percentage = significant / len(miRNAs) * 100

print(f"\nSignificant miRNAs before correction: {significant} out of {len(miRNAs)}")
print(f"Percentage: {percentage:.2f}%")

# Show some top miRNAs
results = pd.DataFrame({'miRNA': miRNAs, 'pvalue': pvalues})
results_sorted = results.sort_values('pvalue')
print("\nTop 10 most significant miRNAs:")
print(results_sorted.head(10).to_string(index=False))

# Write answer
answer_str = f"{percentage:.1f}%"
with open('/workspace/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"<answer>{answer_str}</answer>\n")
print(f"\nAnswer written: {answer_str}")
EOF
